_about: Equipment filter (library + exercise picker). Every dataset `equipment` value in data/raw/exercises.json maps to exactly one filter group. `groups` = the cards of the Equipment sheet, in order. Validated by tools/build_catalog.dart (every dataset value mapped, every group known) and generated into app/lib/features/exercises/data/exercise_filters_data.dart. Reviewed judgement calls are in `_notes`.

_notes.assisted: Partner-assisted stretches and hanging/lying raises: no equipment of their own → none/bodyweight.
_notes.weighted: Bodyweight moves loaded with a plate (weighted crunch, plank, dips, chin-ups) → plate.
_notes.sled machine: Leg press / hack squat sleds → machine.
_notes.rope: Jump rope, battling ropes, rope climb and stretching straps → other.
_notes.suspension_band: No dataset exercise uses a suspension trainer (TRX): the card exists but has 0 results.
